chapter.verse: Tua lai takin Zeisu in a nungzuite kiangah, “Puk nading om loh na’ng thu a om kei hi. Ahih hangin a puksakpa in gimna a thuak ding hi.
Hih naupangte khatpeuh a puksakpa in a ngawngah an-gawina suang khihin tuipi thuk sungah tumcip leh, ama ading a hoih zaw ding hi.
Note na kikem un. Na u na nau in a khialh leh, thu hilhin na taai in. A kisik kik leh, a mawhna na maisak in.
Ni khatin na tungah sagih vei hong khialh khit ciangin hong kihei a, sagih vei dongin, ‘Ka kisikkik hi,’ hong cih leh, ama khialhna na maisak in,” a ci hi.
Sawltakte in, “Komau’ upna khangsak ta in,” ci-in Topa kiangah a gen uh hi.
Topa in, “Note in ankamtang khat cia bang upna nei le-uhteh hih theikung kiangah, ‘Zung tawh kibotkhia-in tuipi sungah na po in,’ na cih uh leh, na thu uh a mang ding hi.”
“Note in nasem khat nei-in, lo kuanin ahi zongin, tuu cingin ahi zongin hong ciah ciangin ama kiangah, ‘Thakhatin hong pai in la, an nekna sabuai ah hong tu in,’ a ci ding no lakah kua ahi hiam?

‘Keima an nek ding hong bawl in; an ka nek tui ka dawn khit matengin kawnggak in la, an hong pia in. Tua nung ciangin nangin an ne-in tui na dawn ding hi,’ ci-in nasempa kiangah gen ding hilo ahi hiam?
Nasempa in a topa thupiak bangin a hih maninah a topa in a phat hiam?

Tuamah bangin note in zong thu khempeuh hong piak bang na hih khit uh ciangin, ‘Kote in a pha bawl lo nasemte ka hi uh hi. Nasemte ka hih uh ciangin a kituak bek ka hih zo uh hi,’ na ci ding uh hi,” ci-in a gen hi.
Zeisu in Jerusalem khuapi lamah a pai lai takin, Samaria gam leh Galile gam a paisuak hi.
Khua khat sungah a lut lai takin miphak sawm in amah dawn uh a, a gamla pan ding-in,
“Topa Zeisu aw, kote hong hehpih in,” ci-in a kiko uh hi.
Zeisu in tuate a muh ciangin, “Pai un la, Pasian’ siampi kiangah va kilak un,” ci-in thu a pia hi. Amaute a pai lai takun damna a ngah uh hi.
Amaute lakah khat in damna a ngah a theih ciangin pai kik a, aw lianpi tawh Pasian phat a;
Zeisu khe kiangah bokin hehpihna a phat hi. Tua pa in Samaria mi ahi hi.
Zeisu in, “Mi sawmte in damna ngah hilo ahi hiam? Adang kua teng koiah om ahi uh hiam?
Hih mi namdangpa khat sim loh hong paikik a, Pasian a phat kuamah om lo ahi hiam?
Nang ding in la, pai in. Na thu upna in nang hong damsak zo hi,” a ci hi.
Farisaite in, “Pasian’ Gam in cik ciangin hong tung ding hiam?” ci-in a dot ciangun Zeisu in, “Pasian’ Gam in mittangin kimu loin a hong tung hi.
‘En in, hih san takah om hi; hua san takah om hi,’ a kici thei kei hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Pasian’ Gam in note sungah a om hi,” a ci hi.
Zeisu in khatvei a nungzuite kiangah, “Note in Mihing Tapa’ hun leh nite khat na muh nop hun uh a hong tung ding hi; ahih hangin na mu kei ding uh hi.
Mite in, ‘En un, hih lai takah a om hi. En un, hua lai takah a om hi,’ ci-in note kiangah hong gen uh hangin na paikhia kei un la, amau nung na zui kei un.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, khuaphialep in van mongkhat panin phia a, van mongkhat dongin a taan’ mah bangin, Mihing Tapa’ ni ciangin a hong tung ding hi.
Ahih hangin a masa-in amah in gimna tampi thuakin, hih khang mite in hong nial ding uh hi.
Noah khan’ lai bangin Mihing Tapa’ ni ciangin zong a hong piang ding hi.
Noah in teembaw sungah a lut ni dongin mite in an ne tui dawnin, kipi kiteengsakin a om uh a, tuiciin a tun’ ciangin amaute khempeuh kisia uh hi.
Tua mah bangin, Lot a khan’ lai takin amaute in an ne tui dawn, sum lei sum zuak, an tuh inn lamin a om uh hi.
Ahih hangin Lot in Sodom khua sung pan a taikhiat ni-in, vantung panin mei leh kat guah bangin hong zu a, amaute khempeuh kang gawp hi.
Mihing Tapa a kilat ni ciangin tua tawh kibangin a piang ding hi.
Tua ni-in inn khum tungah a om mi in inn sunga a sum koih la dingin kumsuk kei hen. Lo lai-ah a omte in tua mah bangin ciahkik kei hen.
Lot’ zi na lungngai un.
Ama nuntakna a gum nuam peuhmah in nuntakna a mangthangsak ding hi. A nuntakna a mangthangsak peuhmah in nuntakna a gum ding hi.
Ke’n kong cih-inah, tua zanin lupna tungah a omkhawm mi nih in, khat kila-in khat kinusia ding hi.
An gawi khawm numei nih in khat kila-in khat kinusia ding hi;
lo lai-a nasem khawm mi khat kila-in khat kinusia ding hi,” ci-in thu a hilh hi.
Amaute in, “Topa aw, koi lai takah tua bangin a piang ding hiam?” ci-in a dot uh ciangin, Zeisu in, “Sapul omna peuhah musanete zong hong kikhawm ding uh hi,” ci-in a gen hi.
